# sustain_http_monitor (Resource)

A website or API's monitor: its address, requested from where it's checked from, and what must answer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sustain_http_monitor" "checkout" {
  name = "Checkout"
  config = {
    url             = "https://shop.example.com/health"
    expected_status = { mode = "range", min_status_code = 200, max_status_code = 299 }
    assertions = [
      {
        id        = "no-store"
        type      = "header"
        name      = "cache-control"
        condition = "equals"
        expected  = { source = "literal", value = "no-store" }
      },
      { id = "in-stock", type = "keyword", condition = "present", value = { source = "literal", value = "In stock" } },
    ]
  }
  check_areas    = ["uk", "eu", "us"]
  places_to_fail = 2
  metadata       = [{ key = "team", value = "shop" }]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `certificate_change_alert` (Boolean) Whether its alert policy is told of an unexpected change of its certificate: another issuer, one that expires no later, or one replaced before half its life. False unless given.
- `certificate_expiry_alert_days` (Number) Days before it expires that the alert policy is told, as an incident; null for none watched. 14 when it isn't given, as Terraform can't ask for null.
- `check_areas` (List of String)
- `check_interval_seconds` (Number)
- `confirmed_by` (String) What confirms a monitor's failed round: verification rounds, each about 15 seconds after the last, or its next scheduled rounds, with no check between them.
- `domain_expiry_alert_days` (Number) Days before it expires that the alert policy is told, as an incident; null for none watched. 30 when it isn't given, as Terraform can't ask for null.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `failure_threshold` (Number)
- `metadata` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `places_to_fail` (Number) Its quorum: how many places failing together fail a round, or every place while fewer answer.
- `private_locations` (List of String) The workspace's private locations it's checked from too, or alone with no `check_areas`, by id, ten at most: none unless given.
- `recovery_threshold` (Number)
- `sla_target_percent` (Number) 99.9 when it isn't given, as Terraform can't ask for null.
- `status_page_visibility` (String) Whether a monitor is shown on the status page.
- `timeout_ms` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The monitor's id.
- `version` (Number) Its version, which a change must name, as its last read.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id in Sustain, as its page in the console, or its API, gives it.
terraform import sustain_http_monitor.checkout <id>
```
